# Paper Benchmark Definitions

`benchmarks/Exampler_B.py` contains the nine SynNBC systems used in the paper.
The dynamics and state sets originate from:

```text
https://github.com/tete0602/SynNBC
```

The bundled case names follow the manuscript numbering `C1`--`C9`. Each
definition also stores its original SynNBC identifier in `source_name`.
